themes.label: Food quality and taste
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and fresh, praising tacos, mole, enchiladas and brunch dishes, though a few found it bland, salty or inauthentic.
quotes: Creative and delicious. Best cactus tacos to date.
The mole was spicy, sweet, and rich, and served as a perfect counterpart to the mild queso fresco enchiladas.

themes.label: Margaritas and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers praise the margaritas on tap, cocktails, tequila selection and happy hour drinks, though one notes the list leans toward beer and liquor.
quotes: Draft margaritas are awesome and only 8 bucks during happy hour.
Mostly beers and hard liquor, not for the people that likes soft fruity drinks

themes.label: Friendly, attentive service
themes.text: Many describe the staff as friendly, quick and attentive, though a few reviewers had poor service or unfulfilled delivery and table waits.

Poor service. Beer's weren't cold and they didn't have more options.

themes.label: Crowded, loud, tight seating
themes.text: Reviewers mention noise, cramped seating and busy periods, though some say the food or atmosphere makes up for it.
quotes: Tight seating but the food makes up for that
Busy times means it gets VERY loud, but overall enjoyable and good.

themes.label: Affordable prices
themes.text: Many find the prices low or reasonable for the portions, with a lunch special and happy hour deals, though one reviewer found it a little pricey.
quotes: Amount of food to price ratio is tremendous
the only thing is a little bit pricey

themes.label: Beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the beer list as wide, varied and good, though one found it not very extensive for a beer hall.

Great food and a wide selection of beers

themes.label: Food vendor variety
themes.text: Several food stalls give plenty of choice and many find the food good, but some note limited vegetarian options, few vendors, or cold food.
quotes: Several food choices. Like having several food trucks next to your favorite bar.
Several vendors with food. not great vegetarian options.

themes.label: Large communal space
themes.text: The huge hall with long benches and plenty of seating suits groups, families and hanging out, though some find it crowded or loud.
quotes: This place is huge (and dog and kid friendly) so this is great for groups.
Communal hall bench style seating, great spot.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food expensive or overpriced, and one found the coffee bar's minimum card spend annoying.

Food was great...a little expensive

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive service, but others reported slow bar service and servers who rarely checked on drinks.
quotes: Bartenders are super friendly, space is clean without feeling pristine/sterile.

themes.label: Homemade pasta quality

quotes: Try the homemade pasta, it really is something special.
Outstanding homemade pasta. Always consistent across the menu. Mama's ragu is the best

themes.label: Friendly, attentive service
themes.text: Many describe the staff as friendly, warm and attentive, though a few reviews report slow service, ignored food or a poor new hire.
quotes: Food was excellent, the service was warm and friendly. The prices were very reasonable.
The service was slow, and the waitress wasn't very knowledgeable about the dishes.

themes.label: Atmosphere and outdoor seating
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, romantic atmosphere and the backyard patio, though one notes it is very loud and another that it gets too hot.

it gets incredibly hot in the summer. The place is hot, the servers are clearly uncomfortable

themes.label: Prices and value

quotes: reasonable wine prices and very reasonable prices overall.
Pricey but the quality is worth it!!

themes.label: Brunch and lunch deals

quotes: Great brunch with $5 mimosas. Outside seating.
Pretty disappointing brunch if truth be told.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious and well prepared, especially the rotisserie chicken, lamb, pork and plantain, though a few found it bland or poorly cooked.

the chicken is SO good and a solid portion.

themes.label: Atmosphere, music and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the relaxed vibe, music, decor and back garden, though some found the music too loud and the seating uncomfortable.

it makes me ignore uncomfortable seating arrangement and very loud muffled music.

themes.label: Price versus portions

the portions are small for the price.

themes.text: Many found the staff friendly and welcoming, but others criticized slow or lacking service, confusing tipping, and the ordering line.

themes.label: Counter-service setup and crowds

So you have to bus your own table. No big deal.

themes.label: Coffee quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the coffee and other drinks as good or excellent, with one complaint of sour, leftover-tasting coffee.
quotes: WiFi is strong and coffee is stronger.
Great service and good tasting coffee.

themes.text: Sandwiches, bagels and breakfast items are widely praised as delicious and fresh, though a few found the food bland, ordinary or poorly made.
quotes: the bagel sandwiches are amazing and it's always cozy and buzzing with friendly neighborhood chatter.
Tasted bland and left me feeling sick to my stomach.

themes.label: Crowding and seating

themes.label: Friendly staff and owners
themes.text: Many describe the owners and staff as friendly, welcoming and attentive, though a few reported rude or unhelpful employees.
quotes: The owner goes out of his way to make customers feel welcome, and the place is always clean.
The owners are always there and are super friendly!

themes.label: Buns

quotes: The pork jowl bun is a perfect barside snack.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Reviewers describe friendly, good and fast service and kind staff, with one saying service needs a little work.

Food is good service needs a little work

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Many call prices fair and portions large, while others find takeout portions small and the cost too high.

themes.label: Bowls and fried chicken

themes.label: Service and staff

quotes: Staff was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable / creative about the menu.

themes.label: Coffee and drinks

Great food. Even better mimosas!!!!

Best tacos in crown heights. Steak, and fried chicken tacos are insane, but everything is good.

themes.label: Margaritas and drinks

Go for the Margaritas... must have!

themes.label: Nachos and queso

the beef stew with peanut sauce served over couscous. It was MOUTHWATERING! The beef was very tender

their craft beer selection was great

themes.text: Some found support kind and quick to credit or refund, while others could not reach anyone or were refused refunds.

themes.label: Slow service and waits
